in-scope.item: Evaluate rules stored in DefinitionJSON at formDefinition.logic.rules
Apply rule actions at runtime in builder preview and renderer
Supported runtime actions: show/hide, enable/disable, require/unrequire
Deterministic rule application using persisted ordering (ordering matters)
Safe handling for missing/broken references (ignore rule + surface warning)

out-of-scope.item: Rule authoring UI and persisted data model changes (Story 3.6)
New operators/actions beyond the existing minimum set

dependencies.dependency: Story 3.6 (Conditional Logic UI + persisted rules in DefinitionJSON)

rule-storage.note: Rules are persisted by Story 3.6 and evaluated at runtime by Story 3.7.

backend-schema.note: Backend validates persisted rule structures; runtime evaluation is frontend-driven.

frontend-types.note: Contains LogicRule/LogicWhen/LogicThen and operator/action enums used by the engine.

determinism.rule: Rules are evaluated in persisted order (top-to-bottom)
Conflict resolution: last applicable rule wins per target property

builder-preview-integration.note: Preview must re-evaluate rules when relevant values or rules change and apply computed visible/enabled/required state.

rule-authoring-ui-touchpoints.note: Story 3.7 must surface runtime warnings for broken/missing references; the Logic Panel already surfaces authoring validation errors.

builder-store.note: Story 3.6 persists rules here; Story 3.7 will add runtime evaluation wiring and computed per-component runtime state (or a dedicated runtime store).

renderer-integration.note: The evaluation engine must be reusable by the form renderer runtime to ensure identical behavior to builder preview.

warning-behavior.rule: Missing source or target component id → ignore rule, emit warning
Invalid operator/value combination → ignore rule, emit warning
No runtime crashes due to malformed/broken rule data
